caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of a woven textile with a repeating pattern in shades of dark blue, red, and beige. The design includes large floral elements, leaves, and various plant-like motifs arranged symmetrically. On the right side, there is a vertical panel containing text, which reads "W. CRAIG W. V. GREENSBURG D. C. IA. 1861" set against a dark blue background. Adjacent to the text block are additional geometric and floral motifs. The textile has a fringed edge on the right, composed of interwoven threads in the same colors as the main body. The overall composition is bordered by thin decorative lines in the same color palette, and the background of the drawing is plain and neutral, emphasizing the details of the textile fragment.
title: Jacquard Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
